title: Diagrams
summary: Editorial charts on 1000x1000 cards: charcoal ground, the title as the theme's big word (heavy Montserrat capitals building letter by letter through a ghost), a hairline rule, tiny tracked labels, Space Mono figures, and fills made of studio-light picture tones (strips, panels, mosaics). Everything lands on the 0.2 s beat with expo-out snaps. Pass "clear": true to float a card over footage. Sample data is illustrative.
usage: {"piece": "d3/bar-chart", "props": {"title": "...", "unit": "...", "items": [{"label": "...", "value": 1}]}}. Optional: tones (kit tone names per series), note (footer, false to hide), index (top-right number). Files: library/themes/modern/d3/pieces/.

items.name: Bar chart
items.description: Bars as studio-tone picture strips snapping up from the baseline one by one on the beat, values counting up above them; the tallest value in white.

items.name: Line chart
items.description: A heavy white trend line drawn over hairline gridlines with a tone picture filling the area under it; square point marks, the last value counting up big at the top left.

items.name: Level columns
items.description: Comparison columns as tall picture strips with staggered tops sliding in from alternate ends; charcoal pours down each to its level, marked by a white line and a heavy percentage.

items.name: Ranking
items.description: Editorial ranked rows: Space Mono rank, heavy name, value on the right and a picture-tone bar sized by value; rows land from the left one beat apart.

items.name: Donut
items.description: Shares as one bold ring of tone-filled segments sweeping round from twelve o'clock; the biggest share counts up huge in the centre, legend row below.

items.name: Percent strips
items.description: Percentages as rows of fifty thin vertical strips; the filled share shows a studio-light picture through the strips while the percentage counts up.

items.name: Versus
items.description: Two picture strips side by side sliding in from opposite ends, each with its label and heavy value; a charcoal VS block on the seam and a split bar of shares below.

items.name: Big number
items.description: One huge heavy figure counting up over three picture strips under a charcoal veil, with a tracked caption. images: stills for the strips.

items.name: Mosaic stats
items.description: Four stats in a 2x2 picture mosaic: cells wipe in from their outer edges, then each figure counts up in heavy white with a tracked caption. images: stills for the cells.

items.name: Timeline
items.description: A contact-sheet timeline: a square marker jumps event to event on the beat, wiping in a tall picture thumbnail above the rule and turning each year from ghost to solid.
